examples.en: I get nauseous whenever I fly.

examples.text: El olor de calcetines sucios me da náusea.
examples.en: The odor of dirty socks makes me gag.

examples.text: Las mujeres embarazadas a menudo sufren náuseas matutinas.
examples.en: Pregnant women often experience morning sickness.

examples.text: Mi esposa tuvo unas terribles náuseas matutinas durante su primer embarazo.
examples.en: My wife had terrible morning sickness during her first pregnancy.
